parameters.command: =powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$action='{{ $json.action }}'; $url='{{ $json.url }}'; if ($action -eq 'open_url') { Start-Process $url; $r=@{success=$true;action='open_url';url=$url} } elseif ($action -eq 'close_browser') { Get-Process -Name 'msedge','chrome','firefox' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; $r=@{success=$true;action='close_browser'} } else { $r=@{success=$false;error=\"Action $action not supported via shell\"} }; $r | ConvertTo-Json -Compress"
